description: This PHP script functions as a client for interacting with the TestLink API, specifically designed to call the getTestCasesForTestPlan method with certain parameters. It includes external utility and sample files, constructs a request using the IXR_Client class, and outputs the test description along with debug information.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: A client class used for making XML-RPC calls, instantiated with a server URL and used to perform remote procedure calls.

methods.name: show_api_db_sample_msg
methods.description: Displays a sample message related to API database usage.

methods.name: runTest
methods.description: Executes the test by invoking the specified method on the client with arguments and test number.
